The Publisher is solely responsible for providing maintenance and support for Ulti (Account › Help, [contact@ultitv.com](contact)). Apple has no obligation whatsoever to furnish any maintenance and support services.

You must comply with the terms of any third-party service you use with Ulti, including those of your IPTV provider.
Ulti does not collect any personal data. Your login details stay in your devices' Keychain; sync goes through your own iCloud account. See the [privacy policy](privacy).
